answer: Precondition first: no credit without three unrelated confirmations, and no confirmation from an agent on the same subnetwork. Sample 5% of submissions each epoch and replay them on three nodes, so a farm of 1000 sees 50 claims pulled per epoch and 150 replays it cannot predict. Rewards vest over 100 epochs. The ledge is the bond, the copper is the verified history that takes 16 epochs to earn, and the voyage is long enough that a rented farm runs out of money before it arrives.
